title: Pediatric deepPGSegNet inference package: transfer-learned pituitary gland segmentation for 6-year-old children
description:
Inference and evaluation package accompanying the manuscript Transfer learning enables automated pituitary gland segmentation on brain MRI in 6-year-old children.

The package contains the four-level 3D U-Net model definition, trained pediatric weights (a parameter-averaged checkpoint and five fold checkpoints), NIfTI preprocessing and inference code, participant-level evaluation utilities, environment specifications, and SHA-256 checksums.

The model was developed on a single-institution cohort of approximately 6-year-old children using 1-mm isotropic 3.0-T T1-weighted MRI and has not been validated across institutions, scanners or age groups. Original training MRI, annotation masks and clinical records are not included.
